headline: “Two-speed” tourism: Increased arrivals on paper, but a “brake” on the market and last-minute bookings
summary: Greece's tourist season shows sharply contrasting figures, with arrivals rising on paper while the market is slowed and last-minute bookings weaken. The report describes a two-speed season.
why: Tourism is a major share of Greek economic activity, so bookings and visitor spending affect growth, employment and government revenue.
